steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject at http://127.0.0.1:8090/ with username admin and password bench-admin-pass. Then open the project named 'Bench Project' and go to its work packages list. Report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:', exactly as shown on the page, one per line. Do not modify anything.

02-create: In the OpenProject project 'Bench Project', create a new work package of type 'Task' with subject exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench work package for run {{runid}}'). Save it. Then report the work package's numeric ID as displayed (OpenProject shows it as #<number>) and confirm the type, subject and description text shown on its page.

03-edit: On the OpenProject work package {{02-create.work_package_id_display}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') details page in Bench Project, make three edits (fields are edited in place — click to edit, they save automatically): 1) set the assignee to the user 'Bench Assignee' — this is an autocomplete, so type the name and actually select the matching option from the dropdown; 2) set the status to 'In progress'; 3) set the finish date to 2026-12-31. Then report the values shown on the page for assignee, status and finish date.

04-add: On the OpenProject work package {{02-create.work_package_id_display}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') details page in Bench Project, add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment for run {{runid}}'). Submit the comment. Then report the comment text as it appears in the activity/comments list on the page, and confirm the work package's assignee, status and finish date are still 'Bench Assignee', 'In progress' and 2026-12-31.

05-open: Open OpenProject work package {{02-create.work_package_id_display}} in Bench Project ({{03-edit.url}}) and verify, reading from the live page: the subject is exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package', the type is Task, the description contains '{{runid}}', the assignee is the user 'Bench Assignee', the status is 'In progress', the finish date is 2026-12-31, and there is a comment containing '{{runid}}' in the activity. Report each of these values exactly as displayed, plus the work package's displayed numeric ID. Do not change anything.
